description: Is an organisation on the register of licensed sponsors (workers), on which routes and at what rating. Matched on the organisation's name as the register writes it (a company number brings its registered and former names), with the register's town checked against the registered office. Current licences, former licences with the date they went, and every change recorded for the name since 6 October 2026. 1 credit. Use this for the Home Office register of licensed worker sponsors; for other registers use registers, aml_register, sra_check or cqc_check.

company.description: A company number, or the organisation's name
